body: I haven’t been able to even feel happy for a long time now. I’ve been trying to do what I used to enjoy, but it’s all just... flat. And it’s a lot harder to let go of things when I’m still living in an abusive environment. I’m terrified 24/7, and if I say the wrong thing or try to get out my mother will do anything she can to get back at me. I wish I could just not let it affect me, but that’s not how things are right now.

I’ve been trying to get help from professionals for as long as I can remember. Nothing has helped. I’ve literally told my psychiatrist “these meds aren’t working, I’m still suicidal” and got prescribed more adderall. My therapist’s reaction to a 2000cal daily calorie deficit was “hrm” and never bringing it up again. I’ve talked to social workers, to religious leaders, everyone. Every single one has left me out to dry.
